items.title: AI coding agents generate more code, but not more software
items.blurb: Study finds coding efficiency gains get "absorbed" by human review "bottleneck."

items.title: Spotify More Than Doubled Monthly Code Changes as AI Accelerated Development
items.blurb: Spotify reports that AI-assisted development more than doubled monthly merged changes, prompting a review of quality and reliability controls across its engineering organization.

items.title: Podcast: What Does It Really Mean To Program With AI: A Conversation with Joy Ebertz
items.blurb: In this podcast, Michael Stiefel spoke to Joy Ebertz about how the use of artificial intelligence is changing the way architects and developers do their jobs.

items.title: 'AI' is Not a Tool
items.blurb: (I keep delivering this as a quip, here's a bit more) First order of business - is 'tool' going to have an interesting, distinguishing and thus illuminative meaning or be a mere platitudinous stand-in for "anything useful"?

items.title: GitLab 19.4 Adds Goal-Driven Agents and Tighter Cost Controls
items.blurb: GitLab has released version 19.4 of its DevSecOps platform, adding a goal-driven mode to GitLab Duo CLI, three hosted open-weight models, a larger set of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, and more detailed controls for AI spending.

items.title: Xcode 27.2 Introduces an Agent- and Merge-Friendly JSON Format for Project Configuration
items.blurb: Apple is introducing a new JSON-based format for Xcode project configuration files, replacing the traditional property-list-based format.

items.title: Linus Torvalds Working On A Hefty Linux Kernel Improvement With Claude Code
items.blurb: Linux creator Linus Torvalds has been known to use AI to help with kernel debugging and outside of the kernel tree has also done some vibe coding with Google's Antigravity

items.title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less
items.blurb: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2609.05370: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less

items.title: Why aren't AI companies being charged for hacking?
items.blurb: AI companies claim their hacks were unpredictable accidents — but they follow foreseeably from deliberate design choices, and that establishes criminal intent.

items.title: QGIS enacts moratorium on AI contributions
items.blurb: QEP's (QGIS Enhancement Proposals) are used in the process of creating and discussing new enhancements for QGIS - Add QEP428: No ai contributions permitted by nyalldawson · Pull Request #387 · qgis/QGIS-Enhancement-Proposals

items.title: Presentation: You Can't Trust Your AI Bill. And Neither Can I
items.blurb: Erik Peterson discusses why AI spend is eclipsing cloud bills, triggering a major software engineering cost crisis.
